text: I locked up at half past five on Thursday and I didn't set foot in the branch again until this morning. I spent the whole holiday at home with my wife.

assertions.claim: I didn't come into the branch over the holiday.
assertions.note: He came in for six minutes on Sunday for his spectacles, escorted by the guard, and was ashamed to say so.

text: I did the service on Saturday afternoon and I was out by five. I tested the doors and the windows. I never touched the vault sensor; that's head office's business.

assertions.claim: I was out of the branch by five on Saturday.
I never touched the vault sensor.
assertions.note: The vault sensor test was on the ticket she was sent. She lied because the vault was emptied the same night.

text: I was in bed by ten on Saturday. My van wasn't anywhere near that bank. I haven't been inside it in thirteen years and I never will be.

assertions.claim: My van was nowhere near the bank on Saturday night.
assertions.note: He lives on Harbour Street. His van is always outside his own door.

text: I finished the audit on Thursday and drove straight to my sister's in Millbrook. I didn't leave her house all weekend and I certainly didn't drive back to Ridgeway. I've had nothing to do with the alarm company, and I haven't been to that branch since Thursday.

assertions.claim: I didn't leave my sister's house all weekend.
I didn't drive back to Ridgeway over the holiday.
I've had nothing to do with the alarm company.
I haven't been to the branch since Thursday.

text: I didn't work over the holiday. The branch was shut. I was at home with my husband.

assertions.claim: I didn't work over the holiday.
assertions.note: The manager paid her cash for an extra clean on Sunday morning, which is against the rules.
